subject: general
question: With which organisation has the Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited signed an MoU to jointly collaborate on strengthening urban infrastructure and sustainable urban development?

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Institute of Urban Affairs (NIUA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **HUDCO has signed an MoU with the National Institute of Urban Affairs (NIUA) to collaborate on urban infrastructure and sustainable urban development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The MoU was signed on November 24 to promote programmes related to urban infrastructure, infrastructure investment, and HUDCO’s Urban Invest Window (UiWIN).**
 
• The partnership also focuses on capacity building through seminars, workshops, conferences, and joint research initiatives.
 
• The agreement is non-binding and will remain valid for five years.
 
• The MoU explores collaboration with multilateral funding agencies to support sustainable urban development projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **HUDCO (Housing and Urban Development Corporation Ltd.)**__

 __
 
• A government-owned PSU under the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
 
• Provides financing and consultancy for housing and urban infrastructure projects
 
• Focuses on sustainable and inclusive urban development
 
 
 
• **NIUA (National Institute of Urban Affairs)**__
 __
 
• Autonomous research and policy organization under Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
 
• Acts as a think tank for urban policy, planning, and governance
 
• Conducts research, capacity building, and urban development initiatives
 
 
 
• **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)**__
 
 
• A formal non-binding agreement outlining collaboration between entities
 
• Framework for cooperation with project-specific agreements signed later
 
• Defines objectives, scope, roles, and duration of partnership
